text:
The power violation points to the bias network. Power is 719 µW, about 2.4× the 300 µW limit. The mirror ratios put almost all the supply current in the output sink M8, and its m=3 multiplier triples its width, roughly tripling the sink current. With m=1 the total would be near 300 µW. Among the filter elements, C1 and R1 most directly set the cutoff and roll-off, so they are the next suspects. R2 and C2 form a pole near 145 MHz, so they are unlikely causes of the fc and attenuation shortfalls. This is a ranking from inspection, not a simulation.
